scripts.text: Good day. My name is Leablem,
and I'm a technician that specializes in
adding slots to weapons and armors.
scripts.translation: 为武器和防具开卡槽的技术员。

scripts.text: It can be very hard sometimes, but I like
scripts.translation: 有时工作很辛苦，不过我喜欢

scripts.text: what I do, and take pride in it.
I've learned most of the things from my brother, Seyablem,
scripts.translation: 我大部分本领都是跟哥哥赛亚布雷姆学的，

scripts.text: but I think I still have a lot to learn.
scripts.translation: 不过我觉得自己还有很多要学。

scripts.text: So please understand my slotting services are limited,
scripts.translation: 所以请理解，我能提供的开槽服务有限，
不像哥哥赛亚布雷姆那样全面。
